plugins\/localthings\/desktop\/php\/loca.Contourne le verrou de sécurité local po: Bypasses the local security lock for devices that accept certain commands even when Smart Control is disabled. Use only when necessary.
plugins\/localthings\/desktop\/php\/loca.Le widget LocalThings organise les comma: The LocalThings widget organizes native Jeedom commands by device type.
plugins\/localthings\/desktop\/php\/loca.Les commandes sont générées depuis les c: Commands are generated based on the device's actual advertised capabilities. Custom commands are not deleted during resynchronization.

plugins\/localthings\/plugin_info\/confi.Laissez vide pour utiliser automatiqueme: Leave blank to automatically use the /24 subnet of the Jeedom internal address.
plugins\/localthings\/plugin_info\/confi.Le rafraîchissement toutes les 10 second: Refreshing every 10 seconds puts a greater strain on the device’s DTLS battery. Reserve this setting for devices that require close monitoring.
plugins\/localthings\/plugin_info\/confi.Les dernières discussions autour du plug: The latest discussions about the plugin
plugins\/localthings\/plugin_info\/confi.Les requêtes CoAP et CBOR sont gérées en: CoAP and CBOR requests are handled in PHP. OpenSSL provides only the DTLS encrypted channel.
plugins\/localthings\/plugin_info\/confi.LocalThings communique directement avec: LocalThings communicates directly with compatible Samsung devices on the local network. No SmartThings account or cloud token is required.
plugins\/localthings\/plugin_info\/confi.Notation CIDR, une plage par ligne ou sé: CIDR notation: one range per line, or separated by a comma or semicolon.

plugins\/localthings\/plugin_info\/confi.Saisir un certificat et une clé: Enter a certificate and a key
plugins\/localthings\/plugin_info\/confi.Télécharge le bundle public utilisé par: Download the public bundle used by the LocalThings project, then store it locally with restricted permissions.
plugins\/localthings\/plugin_info\/confi.Un appareil Samsung n’accepte qu’un clie: A Samsung device can only accept one active local DTLS client. Disable any other LocalThings integrations that control the same devices.
